QuestInfo.name: 2011 Fortune
QuestInfo.0: Find Grandpa Moon Bunny in one of the cities.
QuestInfo.1: Grandpa Moon Bunny asks you to defeat the 2 Gigantic Moon Bunnies attacking #bGrandpa's House#k. You can go there by clicking on the Moon Bunny Invitation that comes #bevery 30 minutes between the hours of 10 AM and 10 PM#k.
QuestInfo.2: Grandpa Moon Bunny asked you to defeat the 2 Gigantic Moon Bunnies attacking #bGrandpa's House#k. You returned after defeating both the #bGigantic Boy Moon Bunny and Gigantic Girl Moon Bunny#k.

1.0: You defeated the two giant moon bunnies, eh? That's good to hear. Now, as for your reward...

mob.0: From 10 am to 10 pm, you can visit my house every 30 minutes and try to drive off the giant moon bunnies. Who knows which one will appear this time? If you can defeat both moon bunnies, I will reward you handsomely.
